name: s4-deny-overrides
description: S4: an explicit forbid on a principal beats any permit that would otherwise apply
policies:
permit(principal in OrgUnit::"fgrn:acme:orgunit:engineering", action == Action::"read", resource in OrgUnit::"fgrn:acme:orgunit:engineering");

forbid(principal == User::"fgrn:acme:principal:contractor_bob", action, resource in OrgUnit::"fgrn:acme:orgunit:engineering");
